scope: Exact byte-identical P3 fixed108 manifest under P8 all-weight-groups BFP8-LoFi. No P8 full108 run exists. The currently completed P8 accuracy gate failed natural accuracy (447/512=87.30%, below 90%; AIME98%, top5 510/512, top100512/512), so no run/admission is presently authorized or implied.
method: Workload-weighted estimate: actual P6 108-row nondecode/case work plus P6 decode work adjusted by the 11 exact matched P8/P6 per-token latency ratio; measured P8 load and post-load overhead are added. Low/high scenarios vary generated-token work, decode latency multiplier, and nondecode work. Full row evidence and calculation anchors are SHA-bound in matched-workload-validation.json.
uncertainty: The 11-row P8 subset is deliberately long-context/anomaly-focused and not representative. P8 changed output lengths on these seeds, so both output-token workload and per-token timing may shift on the complete panel. Planning range is a sensitivity envelope, not confidence interval or measured bound.
not_claimed: No claim that P8 passes accuracy; the natural-accuracy gate currently fails.
No serving throughput inference from diagnostic traced decode.
